prayerExcerpt.en-US: Ask him to be with you in your last hour, and to bring Jesus and Mary to your aid.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Pedi-lhe que esteja convosco em vossa última hora, e que traga Jesus e Maria em vosso auxílio.

meta.face: A southern Italian of about eighty-eight with a pale, parchment-soft olive complexion and a BROAD, BIG-BONED, SQUARE face — a massive, smooth, BALD DOME with a few wisps of white hair above the ears, a STRONG, straight brow, a SHORT, broad nose with a FLATTENED, rounded tip, SMALL, deep-set, kindly dark eyes under BUSHY, white brows, wide cheekbones with softened hollows below, a wide, firm mouth; a SHORT, FULL, ROUNDED white beard and moustache, neatly kept; the gaze lowered to the altar, patient and gentle. Not his order's founder cajetan (round, soft, dark-bearded), the bald, rectangular, ruddy john_leonardi, the gaunt, hook-nosed laurence_justinian, the soft, long francis_caracciolo, the bony, bald peter_alcantara or the clean-shaven, bald andre_soveral.
meta.basis: No portrait from life was found. Later images (the nineteenth-century painting on Italian Wikipedia; the statue on the façade of Sant'Antonio Abate, Milan) show an old, bald priest with a short white beard, which the card keeps; he is shown at the foot of the altar, where the book and the Martyrology say he died, but before his stroke.
